units: Sabb. 141ᵇ לא … במנעל מר׳ וכ׳ a woman must not go out (on the Sabbath) with a flappy (outworn) shoe, nor can it be used for ḥălitsah.

<cite ref="Shabbat 152a:9">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="II Samuel 19:36">II Sam. XIX, 36</cite>) <he>מכאן ששפתותיהן … מִתְרַפְּטוֹת</he> from this we learn that the lips of the old become lax (cannot be smacked, do not enjoy a taste); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 151:1">Yalk. Sam. 151</cite>.
